title: rclpy rate.sleep() hangs forever: create_rate with no executor, sleeping in a callback, and use_sim_time with no /clock, measured
excerpt: Why rate.sleep() blocks forever in rclpy and which fix holds 10 Hz and 100 Hz: spin thread, create_timer, MultiThreadedExecutor, time.sleep, sleep_for and sleep_until compared over 200 iterations, plus sim time with no /clock, destroy, shutdown and Ctrl-C. Measured on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
